description.value:
Choose up to six creatures you can see in a 40-foot cube within range. Each must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be slowed for the duration: it gains 1 slowed level, takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, cannot take reactions, and on its turn may use either an action or a bonus action, not both, making no more than one melee or ranged attack regardless of its abilities or features.

If the creature tries to cast a power with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20; on an 11 or higher, the power doesn't take effect until its next turn, and it must spend that turn's action completing the casting or the power is wasted.

An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
